breakdown.reason: The user provided contradictory instructions: "first-order reflection" (which implies n=1) and "use n = 2". The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect instruction to "use n = 2", thus correctly interpreting the problem as a first-order reflection (n=1). The agent, however, did the opposite. It ignored the "first-order" part and explicitly used n=2 in its calculations, stating "The order of reflection n is 2." This does not match the resolution path taken by the ground truth.
